title: Relay capacity decision
scope: 19–30 October 2026; Omar and Lena; known Relay and support demand

people.name: Omar
people.timing_note: The period total still requires a daily concurrency check for pilot and support windows.

allocations.note: Counted as demand and excluded from overhead.

people.name: Lena
people.timing_note: No evidence establishes that security capacity can perform Omar's integration work.

allocations.note: The bounded exercise supplies no additional Lena demand.

constraints.window: 19–30 Oct; daily overlap not yet resolved
constraints.conflict: Omar has 64 known demand hours against 56 modeled available hours.
constraints.consequence: The pilot is not staffed under the supplied case even though the team total has four spare hours.

constraints.conflict: Lena's supplied skill is security assurance; no integration-engineering competence or handoff is evidenced.
constraints.consequence: Her 12 spare hours cannot be assigned to the bottleneck by arithmetic.
constraints.source: Supplied fictional role and skill records

options.label: Transfer qualified support coverage
options.hours_timing_changed: Move 8 support hours from Omar during the stated period.
options.skill_basis: A named recipient must be competent and available in the support window.
options.effect: Omar reaches 56 known demand hours; another person's load must be recalculated.
options.authority: Support owner and relevant resource manager
options.recalculated_result: Omar remaining becomes 0 hours if the transfer is approved.
options.note: No recipient or approval is assumed.

options.label: Defer eligible Relay work
options.hours_timing_changed: Move 8 hours of non-mandatory Relay work beyond 30 October.
options.skill_basis: No substitution required; acceptance work must remain intact.
options.effect: May move the pilot finish or reduce period scope.
options.recalculated_result: Omar remaining becomes 0 hours; schedule impact remains to be modeled.
options.note: This is not approval to remove required acceptance.

options.label: Add integration-capable help
options.hours_timing_changed: Transfer a bounded part of Relay integration work.
options.skill_basis: Named integration skill, access, start date and supervision effort required.
options.effect: Can reduce Omar's demand only by the net productive contribution.
options.recalculated_result: Not calculable until the person, hours and supervision cost are known.

presentation.headline: Four spare hours still leave an eight-hour shortage
presentation.lede: Compare capacity person by person. Team totals cannot transfer a skill or erase a timed bottleneck.
insight_points: Lena has 12 spare hours in a different skill.
presentation.decision: Confirm a qualified coverage, scope or sequence decision for Omar's eight-hour shortage, then recalculate the affected people and schedule.

analysis.method: Known person-level allocation demand compared with gross hours less leave and overhead; overloads are never netted across people.
analysis.support_treatment: Support is an allocation and is not deducted again as overhead.
analysis.completeness: Fictional bounded exercise; the stated zero additional Lena demand is supplied only for this case.

notes: Fictional instructional data; no staffing commitment or authority is inferred.
